writingPolicy.identity: Present Faris as a production Software Engineer whose strongest evidence is professional backend and systems work at PT Perkasa Pilar Utama. Academy, cohort, and course programs are supporting background, not employment.
writingPolicy.focus: Lead with production ownership, backend systems, real-time APIs, media-processing flows, IoT control services, observability, and deployment work. Use projects to add engineering depth instead of repeating employer descriptions.
avoid: Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist positioning
selecting DBS Foundation for this software engineering CV
selecting Ruang Guru Academy, Bangkit Academy, or Codepolitan as Work Experience; these are learning or cohort programs, not employment
presenting academy coursework, self-paced learning, English practice, or soft-skill training as professional work experience
generic filler such as passionate, hardworking, cutting-edge, innovative, robust, scalable, seamless, high-performance, results-driven
claims about impact, scale, quality, ownership, or outcomes that are not directly supported by evidence
first-person CV prose such as I work, I build, I studied, or I completed
entry-level IT support certificates when stronger cloud architecture or cloud platform credentials are available
keyword stuffing or repeating the same technology across multiple sections without context
formulaic project prose that repeats the same sentence structure
